Additionally, the product checked via get_product_details (4760268021) does not match the product used in the exchange calls (9844888101), creating a potential mismatch. The agent also stated a specific card (Mastercard ending 1531) would be charged without an explicit tool output shown to support that detail. These issues violate the pass criteria, so the outcome fails.
